## Description

Constructs manifold neural networks operating directly on non-Euclidean financial covariance manifolds (Symmetric Positive Definite matrices) for asset return forecasting.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional asset return covariance prediction, cross-sectional portfolio selection.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Hedge Funds, Systematic Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, cross-sectional stock factor features.

## Caveats

Requires Riemannian geometry operations (e.g., logarithmic maps, parallel transport) on SPD manifolds.
